summary: Master the art of portfolio performance measurement and attribution. Join our course to gain essential insights and tools for effective investment analysis.
lede: Performance attribution implementation organizes return data and explains portfolio results through allocation, selection, and interaction effects. For performance analysts, portfolio managers, and investment reporting specialists, it addresses the practical task of reconciling return inputs and comparing portfolio results with benchmarks. Training covers TWRR and MWRR calculations, risk-adjusted measures such as the Sharpe and information ratios, and building attribution tables and performance reports.
audienceIntro: This course suits professionals who produce, review, explain, or govern investment performance evidence across portfolios, mandates, composites, and client reporting cycles. It is appropriate for foundation-level learners with basic investment terminology and intermediate practitioners seeking a more disciplined attribution workflow.
prerequisites: Basic knowledge of investment products, portfolio structures, benchmarks, and financial return concepts is recommended. No programming is required. You should be comfortable with spreadsheet formulas and bring a laptop with Excel or an equivalent spreadsheet application. The course introduces advanced attribution and AI-assisted analytics at an operational and conceptual level, not at production-engineering depth.
